name: carta-crm
description: Manage the Carta CRM conversationally — search, add, update, and enrich investors, companies, contacts, deals, notes, and fundraisings via the Carta CRM MCP Server
problem: Keeping the Carta CRM current means clicking through the app form by form to add or update investors, companies, contacts, deals, and notes — tedious for more than a single record and easy to let go stale.
